challenge.better_approach: Considered copying the pre-commit body into a second hook. That is two doors that can drift; exec of the installed pre-commit keeps one. Considered core.hooksPath, but it changes every hook for every session and is not ours to set.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That the shared-index guard's worry, another session's staged work, cannot arise in a merge. Measured 2026-11-16: git merge refuses to start over a staged index (rc 2), so the index holds only the merge. MERGE_HEAD is written only after the hook, which is why the guard cannot see the merge for itself.
challenge.prior_art: git's own templates/hooks/pre-merge-commit.sample does exactly this: exec the pre-commit hook. In-house, cairn/devices/tester/reseal.py:1119 install_hook is the installer to extend; no ticket in the corpus covers merges.
challenge.real_collision: A distinction, not a collision: artifact.py:994 check_shared_index exempts merges by MERGE_HEAD, which a pre-merge-commit hook cannot see yet. The hook supplies the fact git has not written; the guard's rule is unchanged. The commons' hook belongs to cairn/tools/artifact and is out of this ticket's component.

answers.falsifier: In a scratch repo with the hooks installed, a non-conflicting merge of a branch carrying a record the door refuses leaves HEAD unmoved. Red on origin/main, where the merge commits. Horizon: the next land on main prints the artifact check line.
answers.how: A tracked cairn/devices/tester/hooks/pre-merge-commit that unsets GIT_INDEX_FILE and execs the installed pre-commit hook (git's own pre-merge-commit.sample pattern). install_hook and verify_hook cover both hook files. A proof in a scratch repo, with stub doors, shows a non-conflicting merge of a branch the door refuses is refused, and a clean merge lands.
answers.traces_to: Law 4 and Law 8: the artifact door is physics only if every path into main passes it, and a land is a path into main.
answers.what: A git merge into the cairn repo runs the same commit door as a commit: the artifact check that blocks, then the reseal.

bullets.text: Every land on main skipped the artifact check: a merge runs pre-merge-commit, and none is installed (7 of the last 40 cairn commits, 8 of the last 40 commons commits, measured 2026-11-16). The commons needs the same through the artifact tool's installer, which is a sibling ticket.
